draft.subject: One next step for Pioneer Works
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

You've already got a project created in Wrenfield, which is the main thing — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real tasks there is the natural next step.

If it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever part is least clear and leave you set up.

Best,
Priya
